title: 117 · Chuseok pixel night
provenance: Independent dedicated 160x90 pixel Canvas reconstruction of the entire 12-second reference night scene. Authored dither sky, pixel moon and craters, pounding rabbit and mortar sprite, drifting cloud silhouettes, city windows, traditional tiled houses, persimmons, hanbok crowd, hanging strings, rainbow trails, growing songpyeon platter, Hangul and English bitmap greetings and staggered seven-color vertical wipe. No reference images, source video or frame sequence are loaded at runtime.
editable: All authored pixel geometry, rabbit/crowd sprites, cloud paths, moon pulse, rainbow waves, bitmap greetings and wipe timing in composition.js; palette/pixel resolution/seed in project.json.
fidelity: Full observed timeline implemented with independent pixel art. Exact source dither, silhouettes, small sprite poses, particle coordinates and motion phase differ. No pixel identity, full human realtime playback or aesthetic approval claimed.

portable_demo.textures: Original replaceable schematic assets; not the original reference artwork.
portable_demo.approval: Historical motion implementation; this portable demo is not user-approved.
